title: Mission
body:
Syntax: mission request <d|c|b|a|s> | mission info | mission fail [rank]

All hunt targets must have the Mission flag. Each mob fits exactly one rank relative to your ninja level: D = up to 5 levels above you (or any lower level), C = 6-20 above, B = 21-40 above, A = 41-70 above, S = 71+ above. As you level up, that mob shifts down toward D without overlapping ranks. Minimum levels to request: D 1, C 10, B 25, A 50, S 80. Mission info shows your hunt target, level, VNUM, progress and time remaining. Complete your mission in 30 real-time minutes (including offline), otherwise it fails. Mission fail abandons it. D-Rank gathering missions are still accepted at village boards.

New: MISSION REQUEST DELIVERY <D|C|B|A|S> issues a sealed courier parcel and assigns a real NPC recipient. Use MISSION INFO to find the destination, and DELIVER or GIVE PARCEL <npc> to claim rank-scaled rewards before the 30-minute deadline. See HELP DELIVERY MISSIONS.

Completed missions award random mission points based on rank: D 1-5, C 4-9, B 7-13, A 11-17, S 15-20. The ranges overlap and no mission gives more than 20. If no valid hunt mob exists at your requested rank, the game automatically issues either a mainland-road item recovery (GET the item) or a courier delivery (DELIVER to the assigned reachable NPC), trying the other type if the first is unavailable. See HELP MISSION REWARDS.
